answer: Copying an answer thus yields nothing, and producing 192 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the zenith ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the karst review can re-run it. A near-duplicate is rejected at the fable gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
